units.name: JA_ParseSarif
units.documentation:
Parse SARIF lint output into non-persistent ViolationInfo objects.
Severity mapping from SARIF "level" -> ENUM_Severity:
error   -> Major   (mxcli's Critical-coded rules still surface as 'error')
warning -> Minor
note    -> Suggestion
(Anything that needs to be flagged Critical is upgraded by the reviewer.)
@param Sarif  SARIF JSON string from `mxcli lint --format sarif`
@returns      List of ViolationInfo (non-persistent)

units.name: ACT_Review_CallClaude
units.documentation:
Run the AI review for one ReviewSession:
1. ACT_Review_BuildPrompt -> PromptBundle  (no AI)
2. JA_Claude_Call         -> JSON text     (Anthropic Messages API)
3. ACT_Review_ParseFindings creates Finding entities (currently stubbed)
4. ReviewSession.Status := AwaitingExpertReview
@returns  true when the round-trip + parse succeed, false when prompt
assembly bailed out (BuildPrompt already showed a UI error).
HTTP / key / JSON failures inside JA_Claude_Call surface as
a MendixRuntimeException so the caller can rollback.

the same commit pair reuses this entry. Invalidated when CommitSelection
changes for the parent ReviewSession.

holds the reviewer's pick. Submission copies the selected branch's name into
ReviewSession.Branch.
